question: Should default agent-visible session history, hydrated session-list messages, and last-message previews hide tool-only artifacts and terminal source-delivery confirmations while raw transcript and `includeTools=true` access retain them?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but changing which persisted transcript rows appear by default is a compatibility and product-policy choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Visible Projection
options.body: Adopt the shared projection as the default across all three surfaces, then rebase it onto current main and refresh focused proof.

options.title: Narrow The Projection
options.body: Apply artifact filtering only to agent-facing session tools if API or operator preview consumers must retain terminal delivery confirmations.

options.title: Pause For Transcript Policy
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers define one broader policy for transcript-only records across tools, previews, UI, memory, and debugging surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Visible Projection
recommendation.body: Adopt the shared projection as the default across all three surfaces, then rebase it onto current main and refresh focused proof.
